newsitem.title: UK: Signet shareholders approve capital shake-up.
newsitem.headline: Signet shareholders approve capital shake-up.

text.p: Signet Group Plc said shareholders on Thursday approved the jeweller chains' planned capital shake-up, which gives preference shareholders 82.5 percent of the group's new ordinary share capital.
The stake of ordinary shareholders will vastly dilute to 17.5 percent of the capital.
The capital reorganisation, announced last month, also includes the cancellation of dividend arrears.
Signet said it expected the new ordinary shares to be admitted to the Offical List of the London Stock Exchange on July 21.
Trading in the existing ordinary shares and convertible preference shares will probably cease at 1530 GMT on July 18.
